events.name: Tre Floyd's Church Folk
events.info: The choir has sung, the offering has been counted, -but there's just one problem? $5,000 is missing from the offering plate! Now Pastor Johnson has a church full of suspects and a whole lot of questions. Was it the deacon who knows the church finances a little too well? The choir director with a suspicious story? The church announcer who seems to know everybody's business? Or could the beloved church mother be hiding more than her Bible? Get ready for an unforgettable night of laughs, twists, suspicious characters, and plenty of church foolishness as you try to crack the case alongside Pastor Johnson. You'll have to watch closely, because at New Rock Baptist Tabernacle... everybody has a testimony, but somebody is lying!
